SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.product_id, p.title AS product_title, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.images, '$[0]')) AS product_image, o.buyer_id, o.buyer_name, o.buyer_phone, o.buyer_address, bu.nickname AS buyer_nickname, o.seller_id, su.nickname AS seller_name, o.price, o.status, o.remark, o.expire_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN t_user bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.id LEFT JOIN t_user su ON o.seller_id = su.id WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND (o.buyer_id = #{userId} OR o.seller_id = #{userId})
AND o.status = #{status}
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.product_id, p.title AS product_title, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.images, '$[0]')) AS product_image, o.buyer_id, o.buyer_name, o.buyer_phone, o.buyer_address, bu.nickname AS buyer_nickname, o.seller_id, su.nickname AS seller_name, o.price, o.status, o.remark, o.expire_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN t_user bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.id LEFT JOIN t_user su ON o.seller_id = su.id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
